summary:
Whole Foods Market’s site is wholefoodsmarket.com. The green leaf mark in the tab is the favicon store bookmarks use, separate from Amazon’s smile.

Checked 12 November 2026 against wholefoodsmarket.com. HTML came from https://www.wholefoodsmarket.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon 196x196 → https://m.media-amazon.com/images/S/assets.wholefoodsmarket.com/sales_flyer/img/favicon_196x196.png; apple-touch-icon 180x180 → https://m.media-amazon.com/images/S/assets.wholefoodsmarket.com/sales_flyer/img/favicon_180x180.png; apple-touch-icon 120x120 → https://m.media-amazon.com/images/S/assets.wholefoodsmarket.com/sales_flyer/img/favicon_120x120.png; icon 32x32 → https://m.media-amazon.com/images/S/assets.wholefoodsmarket.com/sales_flyer/img/favicon_32x32.png; icon 16x16 → https://m.media-amazon.com/images/S/assets.wholefoodsmarket.com/sales_flyer/img/favicon_16x16.png.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://www.wholefoodsmarket.com/favicon.ico returned png (32×32, 1355 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://m.media-amazon.com/images/S/assets.wholefoodsmarket.com/sales_flyer/img/favicon_180x180.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #77bb44 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-196x196-03.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-196x196-03.png at 196×196 (png, 9105 bytes) from https://m.media-amazon.com/images/S/assets.wholefoodsmarket.com/sales_flyer/img/favicon_196x196.png.
